title: Measuring and Predicting Image-Token Repair Boundaries in Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.33388v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Degraded images make vision-language models answer wrongly. Using synthetic paired blur, noise, and low light, we trace which clean image states can still repair those answers from the vision encoder through the language model. In four encoder models, 12 to 23 ranked tokens recover half of the full-patch effect, whereas random orders require four to fifteen times as many; encoder-free Gemma needs 22.2 versus 53.1. Full-block repair expires at a model-specific language-model crossing. The matched reverse-direction intervention is algebraically identical to text-token restoration, so its gap from image restoration measures a redundancy band rather than an independent predictor. A clean-image gray-ablation crossing independently predicts held-out repair with 1.53-layer error, against 3.65 for shared depth. Gemma MMBench has the only large attention-to-repair point gap; Gemma GQA does not. Restormer provides a non-oracle consistency check

translated_title: 测量与预测视觉-语言模型中的图像标记修复边界
translated_abstract: 退化图像会使视觉-语言模型给出错误答案。我们使用合成的成对模糊、噪声和低光照数据，从视觉编码器到语言模型追踪哪些干净图像状态仍能修复这些错误答案。在四个编码器模型中，12至23个按排序的标记即可恢复全补丁效应的一半，而随机顺序则需要四到十五倍数量的标记；无编码器的Gemma需要22.2个对比53.1个。全块修复在特定于模型的语言模型交叉点处失效。匹配的反向干预在代数上与文本标记恢复相同，因此它与图像恢复之间的差距衡量的是一个冗余带，而非独立预测因子。干净图像的灰度消融交叉点能以1.53层的误差独立预测保留集上的修复，而共享深度的误差为3.65层。Gemma MMBench是唯一存在较大“注意力-修复点”差距的情况，Gemma GQA则没有。Restormer提供了非预言机的一致性检验。
tldr: 该论文通过合成退化图像追踪视觉-语言模型中的修复机制，发现少量排序图像标记即可恢复大部分修复效应，并提出用干净图像灰度消融交叉点以1.53层误差独立预测修复边界。
en_tdlr: This paper traces repair mechanisms in vision-language models using synthetic degraded images, showing that 12-23 ranked tokens recover half the full-patch repair effect, and proposes that a clean-image gray-ablation crossing independently predicts held-out repair boundaries with 1.53-layer error.
